$comment: Hand-authored brand colour source for the kit. scripts/extract-tokens.mjs reads this file and writes src/styles/tokens.css, src/data/tokens.ts and public/kit/colour/one-agency_tokens_web.{css,json}. The five board colours, white and the logo gradient are from the Figma moodboard; Plum Night and Lavender (origin: concept 01 Nova, one-agency-rebrand-v2 src/data/concepts.ts) were added to the brand palette on 2026-11-23; every other value is derived from them and labelled so. Derivations: mix = OKLab mix of the first colour toward the second by the amount; alpha = the colour at that opacity; value = written as is (aliases, gradients, effects).

brand.name: --navy
brand.label: Navy
brand.role: Brand ground: specimens, the reversed lockup and app tile, AGENCY in the lockup, ink on light grounds.

brand.name: --mint
brand.label: Mint
brand.role: Accent on navy: ONE in the reversed lockup, the CTA fill, focus and highlights on dark. Never text on light grounds.

brand.name: --violet
brand.label: Ultra Violet
brand.role: Primary accent on light: links, accent text and buttons on light grounds. Holds most of the logo gradient.

brand.name: --sky
brand.label: Sky
brand.role: Light panels, tags, the highlight band on light and the light app tile.

brand.name: --mist
brand.label: Mist
brand.role: Supporting neutral: light surfaces and panels.

brand.name: --plum
brand.label: Plum Night
brand.role: Deep ground: premium dark panels, photo-led ads and hero surfaces. White type on top.

brand.name: --lavender
brand.label: Lavender
brand.role: Soft light ground: panels and light surfaces with a violet cast. Navy or Plum Night type on top.

white.name: --paper
white.label: White
white.role: White: the light ground, and type on navy.

logoGradient.name: --gradient-logo
logoGradient.role: The logo gradient as drawn in the masters: Ultra Violet held to 49% (wordmark) or 40% (mark), then to #00FDBA toward the upper left. Use the SVG files for the logo; this CSS value is an approximation for reference.
logoGradient.endNote: The Figma end stop is #00FDBA, a hair off palette Mint #00FAB3: kept as drawn.

ramps.$comment: Tints toward white (positive) and shades (negative) toward navy for the accents, toward black for navy. 0 is the board value.

system.name: --on-accent
system.role: Text and icons on Mint and Sky fills (13.3:1 on Mint).

system.name: --mint-deep
system.role: Pressed step of a Mint fill.

system.name: --violet-deep
system.role: Pressed step of a Violet fill.

system.name: --violet-light
system.role: Violet as text, icon or line on navy, where full Ultra Violet is too dark to read.

system.name: --void
system.role: Deepest ground: the hub's dark page, backdrops and shadows.

system.name: --band
system.role: Alternating band between the page and a card.

system.name: --surface
system.role: Cards and panels on the dark page: the brand navy.

system.name: --surface-2
system.role: Nested cards and inputs on navy.

system.name: --raised
system.role: The lightest dark ground: cards on a card, hover steps.

system.name: --mist-light
system.role: Half Mist into white: a quieter light band.

system.name: --text
system.role: Primary text on navy.

system.name: --text-2
system.role: Secondary text on navy.

system.name: --text-3
system.role: Captions and labels on navy.

system.name: --text-4
system.role: Decorative text only; never carries meaning.

system.name: --ink
system.role: Text on light grounds: the brand navy.

system.name: --ink-2
system.role: Secondary text on light grounds.

system.name: --ink-3
system.role: Captions and labels on light grounds.

system.name: --edge
system.role: Dividers on navy.

system.name: --edge-soft
system.role: Faint dividers on navy.

system.name: --edge-strong
system.role: Interactive boundaries on navy (inputs, outlined buttons): 3:1 or better.

system.name: --gradient
system.role: Signature gradient, Mint to Ultra Violet: rules, card tops and fills. As text on navy its end steps up to --violet-light (see the hub's accent fill).

system.name: --gradient-logo
system.role: The logo gradient as drawn (approximation; use the logo files).

system.name: --hairline
system.value: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mint) 55%, transparent) 35%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet-light) 55%, transparent) 65%, transparent)
system.role: 1px Mint-to-Violet hairline that fades at both ends.

system.name: --stat-divider
system.value: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mint) 70%, transparent) 30%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet-light) 70%, transparent) 70%, transparent)
system.role: Vertical divider between stats.

system.name: --stat-divider-h
system.value: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mint) 70%, transparent) 30%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet-light) 70%, transparent) 70%, transparent)
system.role: Horizontal divider between stacked stats.

style.name: --kit-highlight
style.role: Highlight band on navy, white text on top.

style.name: --kit-highlight-light
style.role: Highlight band on light grounds, navy text on top: Sky.
